ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (20) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

«Совершенствование» (sovershenstvovanie, 'perfecting') is 'perfecting' and «улучшение» (uluchshenie, 'improvement') 'improvement'; «божественное / божеское начало» (bozhestvennoe / bozheskoe nachalo, 'divine principle') is 'divine principle'. The Gospel words are translated from Tolstoy's truncated quotation «Будьте совершенны, как отец ваш небесный» ('Be perfect, as your heavenly father'), without the 'is perfect' and capital 'Father' that the website draft had added.
